# daisyUI tabs

`daisyui-tab.css` is the unmodified tab component from daisyUI 5.7.32, vendored locally to avoid a runtime CDN dependency. MIT license in `daisyui-LICENSE`.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/daisyui@5.7.32/components/tab.css
Documentation: https://daisyui.com/components/tab/

Site colors and focus styles are supplied by `../style.css`; keyboard and panel behavior are in `../script.js`.
